title: Unit Event — Same Dreams, Same Colors — Episode4 An Exciting Night

meta.Event Outline: Kohane and the rest of VBS continue practicing in pursuit of greater growth. However, Toya finds himself struggling to understand the vision that his teammates have for a song due to his lack of life experience. That's when Luka offers some advice!

rows.Line: After school the next day
Outdoor Goods Shop

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This place is massive...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, it's a place just for outdoor equipment. Hey, they even have river kayaks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Going down a river does sound fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But a kayak's a bit out of your reach, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... She said she'd be waiting by the central escalator, so she should be close...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An! Over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane, there you are!
Sorry for making you wait so long.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
I'm really excited since we don't get to go shopping together all that much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start finding what we need. You still need a sleeping bag, right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
Something versatile if possible... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What in the world is this mat used for?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's for putting under your sleeping bag. My dad bought some so we're all set there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A mat for a sleeping bag?
I thought a tent and a sleeping bag were all you needed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even if you're in a tent, it gets pretty cold if you sleep on the ground, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
It'd be good to take some along considering how chilly it's been lately.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? What are these? Cans or...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I think those are gas canisters...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that's what you need for camping stoves. You can even use them to make coffee while climbing up mountains and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Freshly brewed coffee does sound nice... Being out in the wilderness may even make it taste just that much better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But all this browsing may not be good for my wallet. Or can I find a way to work them into my budget...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, it's an instruction manual...
Ah, you use this to hang wet utensils and divide up smaller pieces of equipment.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And this ball... You can make ice cream just by putting ingredients into it and rolling it around?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm glad you're having fun, but we don't have time to look at everything...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Like a kid in a candy store.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, it is fun to look around these kinds of shops.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, look! Isn't this lantern adorable? I think I'll get it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
These cushions are cute too!
This one looks just like a log!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you guys, don't forget that we're going by train and bus. We can't take that much with us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, Mom!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who're you calling Mom...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I kinda like how this chair's been designed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This looks just like a tuning fork... Oh, it's a barbeque fork... And this cup doubles as a bowl...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I never knew that camping equipment could be so interesting...!
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Tomorrow's finally the day when we go camping. But I need to be up early for it, so I should go to bed soon.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've already packed everything I need in my backpack and set my alarm. All that's left is to sleep.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't fall asleep...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(This is so strange.
I've never been so anxious and excited at the same time before.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've always been able to focus and sleep on the eve of a big competition...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But something about this feels different.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is what people mean by being “excited for a field trip”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe...
This'll also be a good experience for me.
The day of the camping trip
Campground

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is a campground...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We made it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa, this place is gorgeous...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! I don't see many other people here. It's like we found a hidden gem.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for telling us about this place, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but to be fair, my dad's the one who actually found this site.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm glad we made it here on time too. It was so hard to tell how long the bus ride would be.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Luckily, we don't have to deal with anyone who always oversleeps and runs late this time around.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe!
Anyway, let's find a place to pitch our tents!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
